visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dyed hair wears a dark denim jacket over a white tank top and a red checkered cloth tied to his waist. He dances energetically in an outdoor area with traditional tiled roofs in the background under bright natural daylight. (2) A woman with reddish-brown hair wears a blue denim dress with a pink bow and dances in a bright yellow indoor room. Behind her, a person in a dark, sea-witch-style costume dances along, with festive bunting hanging on the wall. (3) Two young women in white school uniforms with red bows sing with high energy into a microphone. They are indoors in front of a green chalkboard, their facial expressions are dramatic and focused on the performance while the lighting is bright and flat. The environment is a modern urban plaza with skyscrapers and greenery visible under a cloudy sky. (5) The man and woman from earlier sing into pink and blue microphones in a park setting. They look joyful and are wearing the same casual denim outfits. The background features lush green grass and trees with soft natural lighting. (6) The man, woman, and a young boy stand together indoors against the yellow wall. They hold microphones and smile directly at the camera. The scene ends with a stylized graphic showing the song title and release dates in vibrant purple and yellow colors.
